			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_receipt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_receipt_route value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
				zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
					OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
					SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
					CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
					CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
					STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
					ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
					REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
					AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available
					RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
					RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_amount
					RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_status
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_owner
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_case
					TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					AMOUNT = 1
				}
				if = {
					# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
					# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
					limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved
						SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_status
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					zg361_case_kernel_reserve_transaction_effect = {
						OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
						SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
						CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
						CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
						STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
						ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
						REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
						AVAILABLE_VAR = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_available
						RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved
						RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_amount
						RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_owner
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_case
						TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
						AMOUNT = 1
					}
					if = {
						# Authority contract: route A remains an exact reservation (status 1);
						# route B settles at operation time (status 2).
						limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						zg361_case_kernel_settle_transaction_effect = {
							OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
							SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
							CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
							CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
							STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
							ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
							REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_u_revision
							RESERVED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved
							SETTLED_VAR = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_settled
							RECEIPT_AMOUNT_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_amount
							RECEIPT_STATUS_VAR = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status
							TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
							TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
							TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
							TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
							TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m160_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m160_promotion_slot_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_rubric value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_rubric value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_object_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_object_state value = 4 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_packet_candidate_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m157_packet_candidate }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_quota_used_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m158_quota_used }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_filler_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m161_filler }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_exception_vote_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m162_admission_vote_frozen }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_window_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m163_window_cycles }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_cross_team_share_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m164_candidate_share }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_trial_authority_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m165_authority_bound }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_withdrawal_status_consumed value = var:zg361_pp_m166_withdrawn_before_prescreen }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_rubric_material value = 80 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_rubric_level value = 80 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_rubric_strategy value = 80 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_packet_score value = 240 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_promotion_boundary value = 180 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_boundary_pass value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_rejection_reason value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_packet_score value = 120 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_pass value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_boundary_pass value = 0 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_rejection_reason value = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_political_cut value = 1 } }

				}

				zg361_pp_m160_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m160_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m160_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_u_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_u_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_u_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_u_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_u_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_u_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m160_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m160_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m160_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_rubric
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_u_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m160_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m160_prescreen_rubric } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_resource_conserved value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_partition value = var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_partition add = var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_partition = var:zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_u_promotion_slot_conserved value = 1 } }
		zg361_pp_u_try_advance_04_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m160_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m160_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_u_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_u_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_u_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_expected_state value = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m160_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m160_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2160 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2160 days = 30 } }
	}
}
